name: Find The Cats [95]
desc:
😻 Welcome to Find The Cats! Search through the map and collect cute Cat memes and legendary cartoon Cats!

Update (August 21st):
-Added 4 new cats
-Added a new area

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden Cats
🏃 Use sprint to complete obbies easier
🌟 Unlock cool trails as you progress
🥇 Showcase Cat cards to your friends
🏆 Find all Cats to win!

Some Cats are very well hidden. Find cute Cats with friends and meet new friends along the way!

95 Cats
3 Exclusive Cats
7 Unique Areas

If you encounter a bug, switch servers or join a private server and let us know in the group. If you want to suggest NEW Cats post a message on the FindGames Academy group wall.
